name: Lesbian
overview: Scripture addresses same-sex relations, including those between women, as contrary to God's design, describing such acts as unnatural and abominable (Leviticus 18:22; Romans 1:26). The narrative of Sodom illustrates divine judgment on sexual immorality (Genesis 19:1). While the Bible condemns these behaviors, it also calls believers to avoid judgmental attitudes and instead to pursue love and restoration through Christ, who offers salvation to all who believe (John 3:16; Romans 14:13).
